case.title: Little Red Riding Hood, anime
case.request: make a 30 second video of Little Red Riding Hood but in anime style. Red walks through the forest with her basket, meets the wolf, reaches grandma's cottage, the wolf in grandma's bed, the woodcutter bursts in and saves the day. Studio-Ghibli-like hand-drawn anime look, warm and whimsical, music and ambient sound, no dialogue.
